stories.title: The Oscars are Sunday. NPR's film critic has thoughts
stories.summary: From Timothee Chalamet's comments about opera to the new category of Best Casting, here's what to know ahead of the Academy Awards.

stories.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy concerned as U.S. suspends Russia sanctions
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy meets French President Emmanuel Macron in Paris to increase pressure on Russia, as the U.S. suspends oil sanctions.

stories.title: Life under bombing in Tehran: The diary of an Iranian writer paints a vivid picture
stories.summary: In written messages and voice notes, one resident of Tehran gives a rare and intimate portrayal of life in the Iranian capital under constant bombardment.

stories.title: In layers of melting glacier ice, scientists find a story of pre-industrial pollution
stories.summary: A glacier in Europe holds clues about the activities of pre-industrial people, but it's melting fast.

stories.title: Tick-borne meat allergy can affect livestock producers' health and livelihood
stories.summary: Alpha-Gal syndrome comes from tick bites. It causes severe allergies to some meat and dairy products. For some farmers and ranchers, it not only affects their health but also their livelihood.

stories.title: New Music Friday: Johnny Blue Skies and the Dark Clouds
stories.summary: The country singer-songwriter formerly known as Sturgill Simpson has a new album out under his current stage name, Johnny Blue Skies and the Dark Clouds.
